lede: Grand Theft Auto VI owns the web today: it leads Wikipedia with 519,632 views, and a single first-play video on YouTube has pulled 11,352,352. The other cross-feed story is quieter and heavier, Nvidia learning to run without Jensen Huang, with wire coverage of his exit and a Polymarket contract on his return by year end sitting at a Yes price of just 0.043. On Hacker News the day belonged to security, where an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in Nginx drew 1,262 points.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
throughlines.gist: Rockstar's sequel is the loudest signal on the web today, leading Wikipedia at 519,632 views while a first-play video clears 11 million on YouTube.

throughlines.title: Will Jensen Huang rejoin NVIDIA by December 31, 2026?
throughlines.gist: Wire coverage of Huang's exit from Nvidia is moving markets and biography pages alike, yet bettors see almost no chance of a reversal, with his return priced at a Yes value of 0.043 on Polymarket.

throughlines.title: cursor/plugins
throughlines.gist: Cursor's plugins repo is the fastest riser on GitHub, up 314 stars in a single day.
